PRIVACY & DATA PRACTICES

Privacy Policy

Effective October 17, 2026

On this pageInformation we collectHow we use itService providersYour choicesSecurity and retentionContact

This policy describes the website data practices of DWP Consulting, LLC (“DWP Consulting,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). It applies to information submitted through dwpconsultingllc.com and its contact forms. It does not replace any privacy notice provided under a separate client agreement.

Information we collect

When you request an introductory call, the form asks for your name, email address, optional telephone number, the type of person or organization making the inquiry, the topic you want to discuss, your message, and confirmation that we may contact you. We also use a hidden anti-spam field. Please do not submit account numbers, Social Security numbers, medical information, passwords, tax returns, or other sensitive records through the website.

Our hosting provider may automatically receive technical information needed to deliver and secure the site, such as IP address, browser and device information, request time, referring page, and pages requested. This site does not currently create user accounts, process payments, or intentionally use advertising cookies.

How we use information

  • Review and respond to your inquiry;
  • Arrange an introductory conversation you requested;
  • Protect the website and form from spam, fraud, misuse, or security incidents;
  • Maintain business records and comply with applicable legal obligations; and
  • Improve the clarity, reliability, and performance of the website.

Submitting a form does not create a client, advisory, fiduciary, tax, legal, or confidential professional relationship. Do not send information that requires such a relationship until DWP Consulting confirms an appropriate secure method and any required written engagement is in place.

Service providers and disclosures

The site is hosted through Netlify. Netlify may process website requests and form submissions for hosting, security, spam screening, and delivery to DWP Consulting. We may also disclose information to professional advisers or technology providers that support our operations and are expected to protect it; when required by law, regulation, subpoena, or legal process; or when reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, systems, or users.

Links to LinkedIn, Dynasty Wealth Partners, and other third-party websites take you to services governed by their own privacy policies. DWP Consulting does not control their data practices.

Your choices and requests

You may ask us to provide, correct, or delete information you submitted through this site, subject to legal, regulatory, security, and recordkeeping requirements. Use the contact form, select “Other,” and begin the message with “Privacy request.” We may need to verify your identity before acting.

Security and retention

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards appropriate to the information handled by this website. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure. We retain inquiry information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, legal compliance, dispute resolution, and legitimate business records.

Children

This website is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly request personal information from children through the contact form.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when website functions, vendors, or legal requirements change. The effective date above identifies the current version.

Contact

Send privacy questions or requests through the DWP Consulting contact page and identify the message as a privacy request.
